services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Cruise Lake Winnipesaukee all day on one of our pontoon boat rentals. Or try a wakesurf boat rental if you and your crew are more focused on watersports and tubing. Wake Winni has the boat for you. We only rent to the most experienced boat drivers. If you are not comfortable driving a boat don’t worry, we offer captained charters as well! New Hampshire has a mandatory boating safety certificate law, please expect to acquire this NASBLA certification before arriving for your rental. The perfect boat is the most important piece of your summer vacation in Lake Winnipesaukee, and we’re available to provide the most personalized boat rental experience in the Lakes Region.
